provenance.note: plan half-width from the calibrated top silhouette, both halves averaged, to x 8.05 m; aft of the wing the drawn side lines by hand: the fuselage side is hidden under the wing root, the pylon box x 10.85-13.7 m and the HTP from x 15.8 m. Plateau = preset D/2. FAIRNESS BUDGET RAISED: the drawn waist behind the wing root adds one inflection to the plan line, so the plan budget is 3 instead of 2. Tail end (2026-11-06): under the tailplane the plan line is hidden; it runs straight from the last seen half-width at x 15.85 m to 0.09 m at the end, inside the drawn fin bullet. Plan refit (2026-11-19): forward of the x 8.05 m knot the curve is refitted to the drawn plan outline (stroke centre, scale 21.96 pt/m from the 17.12 m side dimension), whose plateau reads 1.967 m; the plan width is calibrated to the printed 1.96 m diameter (factor 0.996). Forward residual against the calibrated outline rms 0.19 cm, max 0.96 cm (old fit 0.71 / 1.99 cm, widest section 1.990 m, now 1.965 m); aft of 8.05 m the hand lines are held within 0.5 cm.
